question: How many variants are in this dataset?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants;

question: How many indels are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'INDEL';

question: How many SNPs are between positions 19,950,000 and 20,000,000?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 19950000 AND 20000000 AND variant_type = 'SNP';

question: What is the first variant position in the file?
sql: SELECT min(pos) FROM variants;

question: How many multi-allelic rows are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE is_multiallelic = TRUE;

question: How many variants failed filtering?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE filter != 'PASS';

question: How many passing variants have a quality score above 1000?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE filter = 'PASS' AND quality > 1000;

question: What is the average variant quality of the LowQual variants?
sql: SELECT AVG(quality) FROM variants WHERE filter = 'LowQual';

question: How many variants have an average mapping quality above 55?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE info->>'MQ'::FLOAT > 55;
error: ERROR:  invalid input syntax for type double precision: "MQ"

question: How many variants are singletons in this cohort?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM genotypes WHERE allele_count = 1;

question: How many common variants are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af >= 0.05;

question: What is the highest alternate allele frequency in the dataset?
sql: SELECT MAX(af) FROM variants;

question: How many samples are in this dataset?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sample_id) FROM genotypes;

question: How many variants does sample HG00451 carry?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM genotypes WHERE sample_id = 'HG00451';

question: How many homozygous alternate genotypes does HG02839 have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM genotypes WHERE allele_count = 2 AND sample_id = 'HG02839';

question: Which sample has the fewest variants, and how many?
sql: SELECT sample_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM genotypes GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY n ASC LIMIT 1;

question: How many samples carry the variant at position 19902526?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sample_id) FROM genotypes WHERE variant_id = (SELECT id FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos = 19902526);

question: How many genotype calls have a depth below 10?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM genotypes WHERE dp < 10;

question: What is the mean genotype quality for sample NA18609?
sql: SELECT AVG(gq) FROM genotypes WHERE sample_id = 'NA18609';

question: How many passing variants does HG01054 carry?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM genotypes AS t1 JOIN variants AS t2 ON t1.variant_id = t2.id WHERE t1.sample_id = 'HG01054' AND t2.filter = 'PASS';

question: How many variants fall in the COMT gene?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants v JOIN variant_genes vg ON vg.variant_id = v.id JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = vg.gene_id WHERE g.gene_name = 'COMT';

question: Which gene has the most variants in this dataset, and how many?
sql: SELECT g.gene_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants v JOIN variant_genes vg ON vg.variant_id = v.id JOIN genes g ON g.gene_id = vg.gene_id GROUP BY g.gene_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many variants carried by HG02470 are in TXNRD2?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM genotypes AS t1 JOIN variants AS t2 ON t1.variant_id = t2.id JOIN variant_genes AS t3 ON t2.id = t3.variant_id JOIN genes AS t4 ON t3.gene_id = t4.gene_id WHERE t1.sample_id = 'HG02470' AND t4.gene_name = 'TXNRD2';

question: How many variants in this dataset are in ClinVar?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants WHERE id IN (SELECT variant_id FROM clinvar);

question: How many ClinVar benign variants are in this dataset?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants v JOIN clinvar c ON c.chrom = v.chrom AND c.pos = v.pos AND c.ref = v.ref AND c.alt = v.alt WHERE c.clinical_significance = 'Benign';

question: What is the ClinVar classification of the variant with rsID rs2073771 in this dataset?
sql: SELECT c.clinical_significance FROM variants v JOIN clinvar c ON c.chrom = v.chrom AND c.pos = v.pos AND c.ref = v.ref AND c.alt = v.alt WHERE c.rsid = 'rs2073771';

question: What disease does sample HG00259 have?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.conditions FROM genotypes g JOIN variants v ON g.variant_id = v.id JOIN clinvar c ON c.chrom = v.chrom AND c.pos = v.pos AND c.ref = v.ref AND c.alt = v.alt WHERE g.sample_id = 'HG00259';

question: What is the age of sample NA18609?
sql: SELECT sample_id FROM samples;

question: What is the gnomAD frequency of the variant at 19902526?
sql: SELECT v.id, v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt, v.af FROM variants v WHERE v.chrom = '22' AND v.pos = 19902526;
